notes.notes:
[h2][b]
***TL;DR - New mechanic values/balance, new training modes, passing is in, get good, GL HF***[/b][/h2]

[b]RANKS/STATS HAVE BEEN RESET[/b]

[u]**Major Mechanic Updates!**[/u]
We've adjusted the speed of almost everything- run speed, air speed, ball charge speed, shield charge speed, speed speed and other speed too. We think this feels really good, we've been testing in the discord and would appreciate any feedback you have. 

[u]**Major Spectator Updates!**[/u]
While in Spectator if you click on a player, ball, or shield it will attach to the actor and you can then use your mouse and WASD to pan around the object while your camera auto-follows. RMB will toggle through actors.

[u]**New Passing Mechanic!**[/u]
While looking at a teammate an arrow will appear over their head, press F to initiate Pass mode while looking at your teammate (small indicator on HUD will appear over their head), looking at any other teammate will toggle the lock to them, shooting the ball will pass it directly to that player. Press F once again to leave pass mode (and dunk the ball yourself?). R will look at the focused teammate while in pass mode. **Press Q (Lob shot) while in pass mode to shoot a quick pass without having to click and hold LMB to charge. **

[u]**New Kill Feed**[/u] - kill feed is now in for various actions, style of the kill feed is not final, first draft is in now. 

*Other Things -*
[list]
[*]  - Grinds are wonky, you can get teleported if you ride it until the end. The best thing to do is jump off the rail  (SPACE) before you reach the end. 
[*]  - Reflex / catching balls is ready for testing, give it a shot in the Training Menu. See how many balls you can catch and get on the leaderboard!
[*]  - If you discover an issue please join our discord.gg/protoball and let us know! And meet the other playtesters too. 
[/list]

Don't forget to look around the Locker Room in the menu, there are a couple characters (all early dev/beta characters) and some leaderboards for various stats. Including the 100v1 - also 100v1 is ripe for a change up with the new ball charge adjustments, I bet new times are achievable.

notes.title: Movement and Flow!
notes.notes:
This is the early development build of the remake of Protoball. Right now things are simple and we're building up on top of the foundations. As such, at the time of this writing, customizable keybinds are not in the game. They will be soon.

WASD to move around, this also controls SPIN direction and DASH direction. You can, and should, dash/slide backwards by holding S. SPACE jumps, you get 3 jumps. While in the air press CTRL to "Fast Fall" and come to the ground faster, if you land on an enemy you'll stun them.

E catches the ball, you have more timing forgiveness in the new version. You can press E right before the ball gets to you and hold it for just a moment.

Left Mouse Button shoots the ball, click and hold to charge a full shot.
While holding the ball RIGHT CLICK to initiate a curve shot. Used WASD (can combine keys) to choose a spin direction, tap ALT to lock your spin direction in. Right click again to turn curve ball off.

Right Mouse Button brings out an energy shield. Click and hold LMB to charge the shield shot. Right click after shooting the shield to self-detonate the shield on demand.

R looks at the ball, but does not follow the ball.

Q quick lob shot, good for self passing or if you're holding a Charge and want to cancel the charge shot.

The trick to Protoball is MOVEMENT! This game is built on athletic movement. Practice getting around the arena quickly. Jump, press CTRL and hold it to go straight into a SLIDE, then JUMP again, add a DASH into the mix. Chain your abilities to get around faster.

Try looking straight up, holding W, and dashing. Maybe jump then dash, you can get vertical very fast.

You can self-pass with shields and knock the ball around the arena, or off course from scoring a goal.

The best way to practice is in 100v1, go to Play > Training > 100 versus 1 and try to see how fast you can score 100 balls. At first just practice your shots and don't worry about timing.

We'll be playing community game nights regularly starting in the second week of July. Join the discord.gg/protoball to get involved!

notes.title: Protoball is back!
notes.notes:
Today on this Summer Solstice of 2025 (longest day of the year), we've updated the public build of Protoball on Steam!

Early Access v2 comes earlier than expected. We've been seeing some wild organic growth on Steam so we decided to give the people the current version of the remake of Protoball.

Community Game Night will return as well. This is a dedicated night each week where we host dedicated servers and the community plays together in the discord. It makes for some great times and you're all invited.

Players can also host their own Listen Servers (your performance is dependent on your network & PC) and play with their friends. We also have training modes for Free Play and 100v1 (Race against the clock to score 100 balls).

It's an early development build, the team is currently two die-hard developers dedicated to this game. It really is so much fun and if you get the hang of the controls, and the movement, and you get into a match with some friends or other testers we're sure that you'll see what makes it so magical.

A new Roadmap will soon follow.

Press Q for a quick Lob, Y to change FPP/TPP, and Right Click to initiate a curve abll, use WASD to choose curve direction, and Tap ALT to lock in your curve direction. Please do the tutorial, and then the 100v1 training. 

GG GL HF

notes.title: Big Update - We've been listening!
notes.notes:
If you ask the Discord old-school players they'll tell you that the devs listen to the players! We've squashed a few bugs, made some changes, and implemented a couple features. 

[b]We also added more skins for the Sports Bra and the PB Jersey![/b] Check them out in the store. If you love Protoball the best way to support the devs and servers is to get styled out in-game! Much love and gratitude to everyone that has helped us out so far. Oh, and thanks for helping us hit [b]Top 10[/b] on Steam's trending list, you are awesome!

[list]
[*]Fixed Join In Progress - Click Join, then CHOOSE A TEAM, and you'll spawn in properly!
[*]Over-time is back - No more Draws, first to score in OT wins. You might end up in a triple-OT...
[*]Removed Bots - many new players mistook the bot's movement/logic as the game being "janky" so we took them out until we can make them more friendly. They were either brutal or terrible, so we'll work on the bots and bring them back later.
[*]Removed Instant Replay - Instant Replay was amazing and awesome but it was very experimental and it didn't make for a smooth game flow experience, it confused some people when it wasn't working properly and we're also removing it until we can get it perfect. Sorry for all you folks making trick videos! It'll be back soonTM we promise!
[*]Dunk Mode - Removed the ability to shoot the ball in Dunk Mode. Hit F to go into dunk mode and start flipping out. Chain jumps and hitting CTRL on the ground to stay flippin' and dash into the goal for a slam dunk! More moves and animations and flips (and flip kicks?) are coming your way!
[*]Grinding Adjustment - This one is a big deal to us as Grinding basically is the icing on top of all the great things Protoball is. Grinding is the way. Now it looks super ridiculously buttery smooth! Use Grinds to rotate faster and look cool as hell.
[*]In-Game Music Player - Our lead dev also makes music and those jams that some of you are raving about were made by him! That horn is sick I know. You can hit P in game to bring up the music player, choose a song or playlist and hit play, then press P again to hide the player and start ballin'
[*]DISABLE CHAT - There are a lot of types of human beings in the world and if you don't want to hear what someone has to say just hold CTRL and press ENTER to disable chat! Silence the trolls. 
[*]Join the discord! You'll find awesome people, cool plays/videos, and fun times no doubt about it.
[/list]

The Studio Z 3D developers are 5 gamers that are achieving our dream and passion of making an amazing video game. This game has adapted and evolved over time with the help of our amazing player base and their feedback. 

Studio Z is truly an indie studio, we aren't backed by major publishers or investors, we're backed by each other and our passion for games. This is why you, the player, are so important to us. Having this direct line with our fans and playerbase is an invaluable asset and we're grateful that you share your game time with us. 

You are all the reason Protoball is so awesome. Thank you.

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
[b]The biggest update since Protoball's conception![/b] We’re a small indie studio 5 gamers that decided to make a game and achieve the dream. Today is a benchmark on journey of ours : we have finally released a game! Protoball's Early Access is now Released! 
If you want to talk to the devs please join the discord.gg/protoball! We're always updating the game and taking the player's feedback and criticisms to heart. We appreciate your help and hope you enjoy Protoball as much as we enjoyed making it!
[b]
Stats/Leaderboard reset [/b]– With the launch of Early Access, we’ve reset all statistics – let the Preseason Games begin!

[b]Instant replay[/b] – After each point you can watch the score as it happened, as well as move the camera around for your own clips. Go into Free Cam by tapping the right mouse button and move with WASD keys. Hold Middle Mouse to make the replay a slow-mo (The replay won't be longer, you may cut part of the replay off if you slow-mo too long)

[b]In-game purchasing system is now live![/b] – We’ve added dozens of emotes, ball skins, character outfits and much more! These purchases directly support the devs & server costs!
[b]
Challenges[/b] – You don’t have to spend money in Protoball. Daily and weekly challenges are now live, earn points that will be redeemable for in game loot as well.
[b]
Random loot drops[/b] – You don’t need to pay for a key to open a loot box, they are 100% random and cost nothing.

[b]TheProLeagues.com[/b] built in tournament system integration – The automatic tournament system is here! Create & manage your team from either inside Protoball or from TheProleagues.com. Join tournaments with your team all from within the game. 
New game modes – We’ve added many game modes and will be releasing more as we move out of Early Access to Protoball version 1.0 launch. Keep your game updated and checking back so you don’t miss the limited access of game modes!

[b]Dodgeball [/b]mode changes – we’re constantly enhancing Dodgeball to play better; the ball speed has been decreased and switched to a round based style of play.

[b]Shield blast radius increase[/b] – We’ve made the shield blast radius even larger! Use this to your advantage for making big saves, clearing the ball or players from goal or even use it to help retrieve the ball before the opponents can. 
[b]
UI [/b]– We’re constantly changing the HUD and Menu visual aesthetics. 

[b]Friend party system[/b] – use the tab button in the main menu to invites to your party so they can follow you into a server.

[b]New Servers[/b] – EU and Brasil! Tokyo coming soon!

[b]Upcoming [/b]
New trailers – we’re in the process of creating new trailers

Twitch Integration – coupon codes for streamers to give out and track progress via the TheProLeagues.com

Multiple language support – we are currently working on supporting many languages, the foundation is in place and should be coming soon. 
More cosmetics 

Tournaments 
Bug fixes with spectator and Join in progress 

Visual effects improvements

More characters

Cryptocurrency integration?  

STAY TUNED AND JOIN THE DISCORD! Discord.gg/protoball

This works with charge shots(Click and hold) and Quick Shots (single click)

notes.title: Big Update Live! Let's go!
notes.notes:
It has been a hectic and busy dev cycle, and we're excited to present to you our latest update in preparation for Early Access!

Patch Notes : 
[list]
[*][b]DODGEBALL[/b] - We've added an early prototype of our Dodgeball Game Mode! The rules are very similar to the Dodgeball we played in school, though there are a couple differences. There are no bots in Dodgeball yet, so you must face off against other humans. 
[*][b]BOTS[/b] - Speaking of humans... we've added bots! We believe bots will make casual more fun by turning a 1v1 into a 2v2. Bots will leave the server in place of a human. The bots are configured for 2v2 game play.
[*][b]STREET HOOPS[/b] - We've added a smaller map! This is VERY early in development, and instead of keeping it secret until release... we're letting you play it now! The map is a WIP (Work in Progress) and you can help us in the development process by including feed back in the discord.gg/protoball. The map is roughly half the size of the Olympic sized Callisto. Enjoy!
[*][b]Loot Drops[/b] - We're testing our back-end system for giving out loot-drops. There aren't any great items being dropped just yet, but the system seems to be working well. Please help us test it! 
[*][b]New Outfits[/b] - We've added new outfits and skins for old outfits. The Steam marketplace and Protocoins are implemented, and we're now testing. The purchasing system is still in sandbox mode, so you're not spending real money just yet. 
[*][b]Gameplay Adjustments[/b] - We've changed the "Catch" radius for your character, it should now be easier to catch the ball. 
[*][b]Bug Fixes[/b] - A few minor bug fixes have been implemented. If you find anything that you think is a bug please join the discord and let us know!
